summary: Sabre Corp filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its accounts receivable securitization facility (AR Facility) via its indirect subsidiary SPE. Effective September 30, 2026, the facility size increases from $115 million to $130 million, extends maturity to September 28, 2029, and adds a Singapore subsidiary as an originator. The facility includes a $120 million first-in, last-out tranche and a $130 million revolving tranche. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation. No deal terms or strategic event; watch for conditions precedent satisfaction.
